resolution: Instrumented the editor's edit→render loop with a per-verb latency matrix — a baseline to beat. A shared editLatency singleton (cart/hmsc-int/editors/build/editLatency.ts): any edit gesture calls stampEdit(verb) at the keystroke/click, and the loader pane's live-push effect calls takeEditStamp after pushing to the host, logging gesture→push (React reconcile + the push's work — the optimizable part) and gesture→rendered (≈ one requestAnimationFrame later, the felt keystroke→on-screen). Wired ALL verbs the user asked for: place + place·prefab (placeAt), moved/removed/rotated/cloned (the commitMany funnel, verb taken from the event label), and skin/texture (stamped in FacePainter's applyBrush/applyPropTexture since the texture gesture lives outside the loader pane — the module singleton bridges gesture-site to measurement-site, same app instance). Each sample logs '[edit-latency] <verb> gesture→push X ms · gesture→rendered ~Y ms' and the last is stashed on g.__hmscEditLatency for a future HUD. Cart-side TS only — hot-reloads in the running dev host, no rebuild. Honest caveat: gesture→rendered is a one-frame rAF proxy (~±1 frame vs the host's actual present); gesture→push is exact. If we want sub-frame host-timestamped accuracy later it's a small host door. Bundle clean.
